component.title: BulkActionBar
component.purpose: Make multi-record actions scoped, observable, reversible where possible, and recoverable when only part of the request succeeds.

states.description: A selected set is ready for an explicit action.
Progress is visible while selection context remains stable.
Completion is confirmed with the result count.
Failed records are named and retry scope is clear.
Transport failure does not imply that records changed.
Recovery continues with the original selection preserved.

claims.statement: Selection count and scope remain visible through idle, pending, success, partial, and request-error states.
Partial results identify failed items and provide a retry path without hiding successful work.
Actions reflow into full-width touch targets at narrow widths without horizontal overflow.
The contextual action surface remains legible across the declared kits and dark mode.
